description: Shared definitions and types for OpenStreetMap elements

elementRef.description: Reference to an OpenStreetMap element (node, way, or relation)

geoPoint.description: Geographic coordinate pair. Decimal-degree strings, like community.lexicon.location.geo, because the AT Protocol data model has no floats.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180
